en: Conditioned by a non-root, non-inferior state, a root, inferior state arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-root, non-middling state, a non-root, middling state arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a non-non-root, non-middling state, a non-root, middling state arises by way of root-condition.
(Condensed. With respect to root-condition, three; with respect to predominance-condition, three …pe… with respect to non-disappearance-condition, three.
Conditioned by a state that is neither a root nor sublime, a root sublime state arises by way of root-condition. (Condensed. With respect to root, three …pe… with respect to non-disappearance, three.
